contract.assumptions: No physical recovery apparatus,measured Cu loss/recovery,selectivity reset,500h asymmetric-pulse result,full-cycle improvement,novelty or independent scientific review is earned. The separate full research bundle was not acquired. Original heating-value labels are corrected by the supplied linked notice:55.5MJ/kg is approximate HHV,not LHV.
contract.costs: Count signed reduction AND oxidation power,auxiliary/recovery/material/service costs and gas/product inventories. Ordinary same-port waveform/precursor optimization is the strong comparator;PEM+Sabatier modeled efficiency has different process boundaries. Hypothetical180000cycle retention gate does not measure source lambda or recovery r.
contract.obstruction: Measure usable precursor return and sustained selectivity,energy or uptime gain after all recovery costs.
contract.provides: P2 rejects conservation accounting as a useful Doob-control bridge for the Gao CO2-to-methane reactor. Charge/carbon bounds do not identify selectivity or the preferred external command. Standard command-policy likelihood needs the same physical response kernel and positive support;an equally informed ordinary controller ties. Catalyst inventory normalization is an unbuilt candidate;complete-cycle energy/output improvement over the strong source remains unresolved.
contract.requires:
Use the source strongest CEM reactor and actual external voltage/reagent commands;no programmable hidden thermal-noise law. Count stored/non-electrode reducing equivalents,carbon and delayed methane inventories.
Source-reported~60%FE/500h and100+day cycling include electrolyte/membrane service. Illustrative operating points are not integrated source measurements. A copper atom-count reset does not reset substrate,memory or catalytic selectivity.

SUPPLIED CORRECTION:At3.9V andFE=.6,input8FV/f remains~5.017MJ/mol. With rounded50.0MJ/kg methane LHV,reduction-only recovery is~16.0%;the original~17.75% is approximate HHV. For50%LHV reduction-only recovery,the necessary V/f ceiling is~2.08V,not2.31V;atFE=.6/.8/.9,voltage ceilings~1.25/1.66/1.87V. These are representative operating-point calculations,not time-integrated measurements or full-process efficiency bounds. Any full-process comparison must specify LHV/HHV and thermal boundaries and account signed recoverable oxidation work. Conservation/command-control incompatibility is unaffected. Supplied by coordinator for integration,not newly reproved by Capital.
